analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the core value is verifiable provenance and combating digital fraud. A concrete, demonstrable impact metric beyond reduced manual verification steps is needed.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Moderate – Acknowledges skepticism and the challenge of consumer trust.
